cleanupInterpretation: Evaluation completed before cleanup. Evaluator stop returned 5 and server systemctl stop timed out before forced container removal; these are shutdown observations, not failed model calls. Cloud deletion remains a separate parent-owned check.
remainingLimitations: Single synthetic 20-factory cohort, not real-world safety validation.
Three-epoch and archived one-epoch checkpoints were independently trained; epoch count is not a perfectly isolated causal factor.
All four policies used identical proposal opportunities, not identical actual tokens.
Geometric teacher has separately counted privileged planning simulations.
Simulation receipts lack timestamps; final-scoring order is supported by frozen control flow and reconstructed feedback-only prompts.
